notes: Formlabs Form 4, Grey Resin V5. Validated 2026-11-03 with the fit coupon (two coupons and a printed Pin).
Good: 6805, 608 and 6801 bearing seats; Ø25 and Ø12 pegs in the 6805 and 6801 bores; planet pin hole; dowel; M3 and M5 screw holes; M5 nut slot; output hex socket with the printed Pin.
Bushing hole: tight, needs light tapping; the pin still slides and turns in the pressed bushing and there is no whitening. Press bushings in with a vise or arbor press.
Threaded-insert holes (RESIN Ø4.8 / Ø7.3, for epoxy bonding): good dry fit for the ruthex M3 and M5 inserts; bonding not yet tried.
Washed and post-cured as for the coupons. A new resin, printer or post-cure needs a new coupon.
